item.title: Murmurly 1.12.0
item.description:
Cleanup that follows the app

New in Settings → AI: Per-app styles, off until you switch it on. When it's on, cleanup adapts to the app you were in when you pressed the key.

  • Raw for terminals and code editors: no cleanup at all, the words exactly as recognised. No stray capital, no full stop.
  • Casual for Slack, Messages and other chat: contractions kept, punctuation kept light, fillers still removed.
  • Formal for Mail and Outlook: complete sentences, contractions written out.

Turning it on seeds sensible rules for the apps you have installed. Change any of them, remove any, or add another app.

Coming from Murmur 1.10

If you still have Murmur 1.10, this is a fresh install rather than an update: download Murmurly from murmurly.prayasmittal.com and drag it to Applications. Murmurly 1.11 updates normally.
